library_preparation_preflight.summary: spring-modulith-events-jackson is a pure serialization support module (JacksonEventSerializer wrapping a JsonMapper/ObjectMapper). Its POM pulls in spring-modulith-events-core and a non-optional tools.jackson.core:jackson-databind:3.1.4 dependency, which Gradle resolves transitively for the test scaffold automatically — Jackson 3 metadata already exists in this repo (tools.jackson.core/jackson-databind), so nothing new is introduced. No database, broker, or external service is involved, so no Docker image is needed, and no env var or system property gates its behavior.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Exercise JacksonEventSerializer.serialize/deserialize round-trips against plain POJO/record event types; no Spring context or container is required. The module also declares an optional com.fasterxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind:2.21.4 (classic Jackson 2) fallback for environments without Jackson 3 on the classpath — that path is secondary and not needed for meaningful coverage of the module's default behavior, so don't add it unless native-image verification shows otherwise.
